title: Gary Marcus reports tens of thousands of incidents linked to AI agents, far more than has emerged so far. He accuses companies and the US government
content_md:
Gary Marcus segnala decine di migliaia di incidenti collegati ad agenti IA, molto più di quanto emerso finora. Accusa aziende e governo USA 

via Mastodon https://garymarcus.substack.com/p/breaking-ai-agent-incident-toll-has
exclude_reason: Opinion commentary (Gary Marcus substack) on AI agent incidents; advocacy piece, not a security event.
